title: Digital Currency Shift
description: Major central banks announce pilot for interoperable CBDCs.

content.text: The move towards Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDCs) is accelerating with a new focus on cross-border interoperability.

content.label: The Pilot
content.text: A consortium of 5 central banks will test a shared ledger for instant settlements.

content.label: Benefit
content.text: Reduction of settlement times from 3 days to 3 seconds.
